top_signals.summary: Indonesian sovereign wealth fund Danantara’s planned dollar notes are unlikely to price quickly as a global bond rout clouds debt issuance, people familiar with the matter said.

top_signals.title: Lloyds Banking Group CEO on Earnings, 2030 Plan
top_signals.summary: Lloyds Banking Group Chief Executive Officer Charlie Nunn speaks on Bloomberg Television after the lender's second-quarter earnings beat estimates and the bank unveiled a blueprint to help boost non-banking revenues by 2030. "We've got some exciting growth to do," Nunn says. (Source: Bloomberg)
